## Setting up R environment with essential packages.

- **Installing Required Packages**


```{r install-packages, results='hide'}
   # install.packages(c("sf", "terra", "tmap", "leaflet", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", "spData", "rayshader", "viridis"))
```

- **Loading the packages**

```{r load-libraries, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)
library(rayshader)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
library(spData)
```

data(package = "spData")

### To create a map using R basic plot
```{r}
plot(nigeria["name_long"])
```

```{r}
plot(Africa)
```

```{r}
plot(Africa["geom"])
```


```{r}
plot(st_geometry(Africa))
```


#### To modify the plot
```{r}
plot(st_geometry(Africa), 
     main = "Map of Africa",
     cex.main = 2,         # Title size
     col = "lightblue",    # Fill color
     border = "darkblue")  # Border color

```

#### Adding labels on the map 
```{r}
plot(st_geometry(Africa), main = "African Countries")
text(st_coordinates(st_centroid(Africa)), labels = Africa$name_long, cex = 0.6)
```

#### Increasing the size of the map, title name and label name
```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}
plot(st_geometry(Africa), 
     main = "Map of Africa", cex.main = 5) 
text(st_coordinates(st_centroid(Africa)), 
     labels = Africa$name_long, cex = 2.5)
```


```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}
plot(st_geometry(Africa),
     main = "Map of Africa", 
     cex.main = 5, 
     col = "lightblue", 
     border = "darkgreen") 
text(st_coordinates(st_centroid(Africa)), 
     labels = Africa$name_long, 
     cex = 2.5,
     col = "black")
```


#### To highlight Nigeria using a different color
```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}
country_colors <- ifelse(Africa$name_long == "Nigeria", "green", "black")

plot(
  st_geometry(Africa),          
  main = "Map of Africa",       
  cex.main = 5,                 
  col = country_colors,           
  border = "white")      
text(st_coordinates(st_centroid(Africa)),  
  labels = Africa$iso_a2,            
  cex = 2.6,                            
  col = "white"                       
)

```


### Highlighting two countries
```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}
congo_colors <- ifelse(Africa$name_long %in% c("Republic of the Congo", "Democratic Republic of the Congo"),
  c("orange", "red")[match(Africa$name_long, c("Republic of the Congo", "Democratic Republic of the Congo"))],
  "lightblue"
)

plot(
  st_geometry(Africa),
  main = "Map of Africa",
  cex.main = 5,
  col = congo_colors,
  border = "black"
)

text(st_coordinates(st_centroid(Africa)),
  labels = Africa$name_long,
  cex = 2.0,
  col = "black"
)

```


### Choropleth map - GDP by continent, using color gradients to show differences in economic output.
```{r}
plot(Africa["gdpPercap"], main = "GDP per Capita in Africa")
```


## Creating map using  ggplot2

```{r}
ggplot(data = Africa) +
  geom_sf(fill = "darkblue", color = "black") +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = name_long), size = 2, color = "white") +
  ggtitle("Map of Africa")

```


```{r, fig.width= 30, fig.height= 30}
ggplot(data = Africa) +
  geom_sf(fill = "darkblue", color = "black") +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = name_long), size = 10, color = "white") +
  ggtitle("Map of Africa")+
 theme(plot.title = element_text(
   size = 28, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = Africa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = subregion), color = "black") +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = iso_a2), size = 2.5, color = "white") +
  ggtitle("Map of Africa") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

```


```{r}
ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = continent), color = "white") +
  ggtitle("World Map by Continent") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(Africa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = gdpPercap)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", na.value = "grey90", name = "GDP per Capita") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GDP per Capita in Africa")

```

```{r}
ggplot(Africa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = gdpPercap)) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", na.value = "grey90", name = "GDP per Capita") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GDP per Capita in Africa")
```


## tmap 
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
tmap_mode("view")  # Interactive map
tm_shape(Africa) +
  tm_polygons("gdpPercap", palette = "Blues", title = "GDP per Capita")
```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(world) +
  tm_polygons("gdpPercap", palette = "Blues") +
  tm_facets(by = "continent", ncol = 3) +
  tm_layout(title = "GDP per Capita by continent")


```



### Leaflet 
```{r}
leaflet(Africa) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(fillColor = ~colorNumeric("Blues", gdpPercap)(gdpPercap),
              color = "black",
              weight = 1,
              opacity = 1,
              fillOpacity = 0.7,
              label = ~paste(name_long, "<br>", "GDP per Capita:", round(gdpPercap, 0))) %>%
  addLegend(pal = colorNumeric("Blues", Africa$gdpPercap),
            values = Africa$gdpPercap,
            title = "GDP per Capita")

```



```{r}
knitr::include_graphics("africa_gdp_3d.png")

# Create a ggplot map (2D version)
africa_map <- ggplot(Africa) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = gdpPercap), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "C", na.value = "grey90", name = "GDP per Capita") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GDP per Capita in Africa")

# Convert to 3D using rayshader
plot_gg(africa_map,
        multicore = TRUE,
        width = 5,
        height = 5,
        scale = 300,        # Adjust this for exaggeration
        windowsize = c(1000, 800),
        zoom = 0.6,
        phi = 40,
        theta = 135,
        fov = 60)
```
